# pantechdynamics_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up one SSH key already registered to the account, by id or name, to install it on instances without managing it. A generated private key is never readable again, so it is not available here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a registered SSH key up by name (or by id), to install it on instances
# without managing it.
data "pantechdynamics_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name = "laptop"
}

output "laptop_fingerprint" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_ssh_key.laptop.fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the SSH key to look up, starting with sshk_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the SSH key to look up. It must match exactly. Names are unique in the account. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the key was registered, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key, in OpenSSH format.
